parameters.content:
## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #02 BLUEPRINT
### Self-Host n8n on Hostinger VPS (1-Click Setup Starter Kit)

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep02&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Timestamp_UTC | Server_Engine | Memory_Usage | HTTP_Latency_ms | Server_Status`
* [Open Episode #02 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep02/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TJuo4kIFhbY)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Runs an automated 24/7 hourly heartbeat & performs a live HTTP latency check.
* **Zone 2:** Inspects real runtime memory (`process.memoryUsage()`) & uptime telemetry of your self-hosted n8n container.
* **Zone 3:** Verifies health status and logs 24/7 cloud uptime directly to Google Sheets.

---
*📂 Need more free templates? Visit [360rev-hub.github.io](https://360rev-hub.github.io/?src=json_footer)*

## STEP 1: 24/7 Cloud Heartbeat & External Ping
1. **1. 24/7 Cloud Heartbeat (Trigger)** runs every hour on your [Hostinger KVM 1 Cloud](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep02&src=json_step1) even while your laptop is OFF.
2. **2. Live HTTP Connectivity Check** pings `https://api.n8n.io` to verify outbound SSL & network speed.

## STEP 2: Real Container RAM & Runtime Diagnostics
1. **3. Read Live Container RAM & Uptime** reads real Node.js heap/RSS memory and container uptime.
2. **4. Is Server Healthy?** checks that memory usage is within optimal bounds.

## STEP 3: Log Uptime to Google Sheets & Activate!
1. Double-click **5. Log Cloud Uptime to Google Sheets** -> select your sheet.
2. Click **Test workflow**, then flip the top-right switch to **Active**!
